high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Google News feed on a mobile device. The top part of the screen shows the time as 4:10, along with various status icons such as Bluetooth, LTE, and battery level at 76%. Below that, there is a headline from Zee News titled "Is that Niagara falls? Twitter users ask after video of water flowing over Delhi over-bridge surfaces," dated "Yesterday." The main content of the article includes two images showing vehicles driving through a flooded road. The water appears to be flowing over a bridge, creating a scene that resembles Niagara Falls.
